name: Ryze AI — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO & GEO
description:
Ryze AI is the MCP connector for paid ads and SEO. Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Ads), Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Merchant Center, Shopify, HubSpot, PostHog, Webflow, Google Drive and OpenAI (ChatGPT) Ads to one Ryze workspace, then audit, report and optimize all of them from a single Claude conversation.

Google Ads MCP: audit accounts for wasted spend, search terms, budget pacing, disapproved ads and conversion tracking; run GAQL reports; keyword research with search volume, competition and CPC; apply or dismiss recommendations; pause campaigns, change bids and budgets, add keywords and negatives; create custom audiences; upload Performance Max image assets.

Meta Ads MCP: Facebook and Instagram campaign performance, ad creatives, lead forms, Ad Library competitor research, Graph API reads and writes.

SEO / GEO / AEO: Search Console queries and pages, click and ranking changes, indexation summary, URL inspection, sitemap submission, plus GA4 AI-referral traffic (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) by engine and landing page — measure generative engine optimization and answer engine optimization, not just organic rankings.

Analytics and reporting: GA4 standard, realtime and pivot reports; cross-platform Google + Meta + GA4 tables with true CPA/ROAS; write results to Google Sheets and Docs; schedule recurring reports and actions delivered by email or Slack.

Ecommerce and CRM: Shopify products and orders, HubSpot contacts and deals, Merchant Center product issues, PostHog analytics, Webflow CMS.

Safe by default: read tools are read-only, destructive operations are flagged and need item-by-item confirmation, and every action runs under the permissions of the accounts you connected in Ryze. Used by 2,000+ brands and agencies for PPC, ecommerce marketing and SEO.

Requires a Ryze AI account (free trial at app.get-ryze.ai) with at least one platform connected. Tools shown depend on what your workspace has connected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ryze AI — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO & GEO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ryze AI — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO & GEO to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://connector.get-ryze.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ryze AI — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO & GEO MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ryze AI — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO & GEO lists 73 MCP tools, including google_ads__applyRecommendation, google_ads__dismissRecommendation, google_ads__generateKeywordHistoricalMetrics, google_ads__generateKeywordIdeas, google_ads__getAccountHierarchy, google_ads__getAccountSummary, google_ads__listAccessibleCustomers, google_ads__listConversionActions, google_ads__listRecommendations, google_ads__runRawCustomAudienceMutate, google_ads__runRawGaql, and google_ads__runRawMutate.
